Netanyahu said Barak's ties show Epstein did not work for Israel.

Born 1942, Kibbutz Mishmar Hasharon; IDF 1959; commanded an elite unit; head of Intelligence Branch April 1983; Central Command Jan 1986; 14th Chief of General Staff April 1991; Interior Minister Jul–Nov 1995; Foreign Minister Nov 1995–Jun 1996; Labor chairman 1996; elected PM 17 May 1999, in office 6 July 1999 (also Defence); resigned 10 Dec 2000; lost 2001 to Sharon, term ended 7 March 2001; Labor leader and Defence Minister June 2007; Defence Minister under Netanyahu March 2009; formed Atzmaut Jan 2011; announced exit Nov 2012.
